subtitle: Controlling what users get told, and how

caption: Setup → Notification Builder → Custom Notifications is where an admin defines new notification types.
A Custom Notification Type names the alert and picks its channels — Desktop, Mobile, or both.
The new type shows up ready to be fired — by a Flow or Process Builder — with Desktop and Mobile both enabled.
The bell icon badges, and the dropdown shows the custom message a Flow actually sent.
